description: 16.1.B&C Actual Generation per Production Type (A75) and 6.1.A&B Actual Total Load (A65) for IT-Sardinia (10Y1001A1001A74G). Native quarter-hourly resolution from 1 October 2025 onward (hourly data before that is expanded into four identical quarter-hour points). Hourly values are the average of the quarter-hour values within the hour; daily values are the sum of the hourly values (approximate MWh/day). Times are Italian market time (Europe/Rome), labelled by elapsed time since local midnight like GME periods.
